title: Spot the Phishing Email
instructions: Identify phishing attempts by analyzing the sender, content, and urgency.

questions.question: Your bank asks you to verify your account by clicking a link.
questions.hint: Banks do not ask for information through links.

questions.question: An email from HR asks for your ID card image to update records.
questions.hint: Check if sender's email domain is authentic.

questions.question: You receive a message: 'Your package cannot be delivered. Update info here.'
